Drop real project screenshots in here and they'll replace the
generated placeholders in the project popups automatically.

Name them by project slug (PNG format):

  enesis-space.png
  rest-api-dashboard.png
  capstone.png
  integrations.png
  games.png

Recommended size: about 1280x760 (16:9.5-ish). They get cropped
to fit, so keep the important stuff centered.
